access_rule: Readable ONLY by pipeline/analysis/confirmatory.py, executed after a pre-registration for the hypothesis has been committed to git. Generation-zone agents (literature-mapper, gap-finder, plausibility-filter, feasibility-checker, novelty-scorer) must never read this file. The /preregister command reads the endpoint_registry section only, and only to copy an endpoint definition into the prereg document.
description: Definitions of outcome fields and the partition gating state. Patient-level outcome VALUES are not stored in this repository; this manifest points at them and records which slices have been unlocked, by which prereg, and when.

endpoint_registry.label: Overall survival
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index date to death from any cause; censored at last known contact.
endpoint_registry.censoring: administrative at data cutoff; last contact otherwise
known_biases: Left truncation at sequencing date — risk set must be entered at days_dx_to_sequencing, not at diagnosis.

endpoint_registry.label: Time to treatment discontinuation
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to permanent discontinuation of the index regimen or death.
known_biases: Discontinuation for toxicity is conflated with discontinuation for progression.

endpoint_registry.label: Time to next treatment
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to start of the subsequent line or death.
known_biases: Patients who leave the health system are censored informatively.

endpoint_registry.label: Radiology-assessed progression-free survival
endpoint_registry.definition: Days from index treatment start to NLP-extracted radiology progression or death.
known_biases: NLP progression extraction is imperfect; assessment intervals are non-uniform (informative censoring).

exploration.purpose: Never used for confirmatory testing. Reserved for future methods work; outcomes here are still gated.

test.purpose: Primary confirmatory partition. Unlocked slice-by-slice by committed pre-registrations.
test.data_pointer: EXTERNAL — configure via PIPELINE_LOCKED_DATA_PATH; no patient data is committed to this repository.

temporal_holdout.purpose: External replication. Patients with first_contact_year >= holdout_cutoff_year. Opened only after a hypothesis has a completed confirmatory result on the test partition.

unlock_log_note: Append-only. Each entry: {hypothesis_id, prereg_file, prereg_commit_sha, partition, endpoint_id, unlocked_utc, unlocked_by}. Written by /preregister after the prereg commit succeeds, never before.
